messages:
elaine: heads-up  i'm opening a PR to update the model-catalog/model-card guidance for supported quant variants, CLI snippets, and a short migration note for SDK users. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1482

sam: Awesome. Can you call out which SDK versions include the new client flag for quantized fallback? We should include the exact pip install lines and a tiny snippet.

diego: Also make sure the model-card fields include: supported_quant (list), seq_limit_per_variant, and recommended_batching. Some older cards only mention "quantized" generically.

elaine: Good points. Plan: add a new subheading "Quant and migration notes" in the model card template, add supported_quant array, and show a sample SDK snippet.

ravi: For the SDK example, keep it minimal. Something like:
```
# python sdk snippet to request quantized variant with fallback
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
resp = client.generate(
  model='nebula3b',
  variant='nebula3b-int8',
  prompt='summarize: ...',
  fallback_variants=['nebula3b-fp16']
)
print(resp.text)
```

sam: Perfect. Also include the CLI example for perf-harness and link to the perf-harness repo. The current docs have a stale link to /perf/benchmarks.

elaine: I'll update all outdated links. Adding: "If you see a stale perf link, replace with https://github.com/redwood-inference/perf-harness" in the PR description.

diego: Can we add a short note about expected behavior of seq ceilings when going from fp16->int4? Some customers assume same context length; we should say "verify with the variant's seq_limit_per_variant field".

elaine: Adding that exact sentence. Also including an example table showing: variant, device-tested (a100/h100), p50 ms, tokens/s, seq_limit.

sam: Reviewer ask: can someone from eng-ml sanity-check the latency numbers and the example SDK flag name? I can do docs copyedit.

ravi: I'll ping @diego on eng-ml and add a quick checklist item in the PR: "eng-ml verify numbers".

docs-bot: Reminder: Add changelog entry and set label docs, perf-needed if numbers are changed. (automated)

elaine: One more tiny thing  please avoid adding long tables for every single model. Instead link the model-catalog table and include a 2-row illustrative example in the card template.

diego: SGTM. If perf run is needed we should create a follow-up GH issue and reference it in the PR so docs reviewers know it's pending.

sam: I'll do editorial pass after eng-ml signoff. ETA EOD.

elaine: thanks all. tagging the PR description with TODOs for link fixes, SDK snippet, seq-ceiling language, and perf-run follow-up. last_message_ts=3421112599
